title: snort: convert to ws_log system
description:
Use the ws_log system instead of custom debug routines. If Wireshark
isn't compiled for the Debug target, the compiler will optimize away all
these calls.

Remove `snort_debug_printf()` function; call `ws_debug()` instead.
Remove trailing newlines from logged messages.

Ping #19519

changes_data.diff:
@@ -14,14 +14,6 @@
 
 #include <glib.h>
 
-/* #define SNORT_CONFIG_DEBUG */
-#ifdef  SNORT_CONFIG_DEBUG
-#include <stdio.h>
-#define snort_debug_printf printf
-#else
-#define snort_debug_printf(...)
-#endif
-
 /************************************************************************/
 /* Rule related data types                                              */
